rules.quote: works by turning ProjectE's *EMC* into a distinct "key type" able to be displayed, reported and manipulated by an ME
rules.topic: AppliedE makes ProjectE EMC a first-class AE2 key type: the ME network displays and moves EMC like a resource, and learned items become craftable through AE2 auto-crafting, paid from the pool (author's README, repo root)

value.model: EMC is an ME key type

rules.topic: Access comes from an ME Transmutation Module bound to the player who placed it (their ProjectE knowledge and EMC pool); only one module per knowledge provider counts on a network, and with several providers, inserted and extracted EMC is split equally among them (author's README)

value.providers: one contributing module per player; EMC split equally across providers

rules.topic: The author flags AppliedE as early beta with possible critical bugs, especially on multiplayer servers; treat EMC-through-ME automation as powerful but fragile, and keep ProjectE's own table as the fallback path
